name: FrenchModelVariant474_HandleRequest
evidence: matching french_model_variant/variant474_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4; for a non-negative request it selects the 0x34-byte configuration row at data + 0x1C indexed by the request and packs the five texture images before the table, otherwise it runs one frame and calls the paired-funnel and ribbon helpers; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md, notes/overlays/french-model-variant474-entry.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the US and Japanese header-457 images build the same source through model_variant/variant457_entry.c, which selects CLUT x 512 instead of 640, and bind the table 0x68 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
